skill.displayName: See Through Clothes Filter – Create Transparent Outfit Effects Online – API-powered
skill.summary: See-through clothes filter — make clothing appear sheer and see-through

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of see-through-clothes-fitler-openapi-skill

- Provides an API-driven filter to make clothing appear sheer and see-through in images.
- Supports image upload, custom sheer fabric instructions, and batch generation (up to 16 images).
- Requires a WeShop API key for authentication (only sent to openapi.weshop.ai).
- Includes secure API key handling guidelines and polling for operation status.
- Lists available endpoints and input fields for easy integration.
